parts.title: Part 3 · Dictation
parts.instr: Your teacher reads the dictation. Write what you hear in the box.
chunks: We say, one person, but two people.

parts.text: We're reading, not writing. That's his pullover and these are her tights. These are our skirts. Those are their trousers. Your handkerchief is in your pocket. Her blouse is grey. Miss Smith is not French or German; she's English. We say, one person, but two people. He's coming from London and going to Beijing.
